known_measurement_limits: Claim correctness, completeness, and full faithfulness require reviewed full-evidence or calibrated-judge scoring and are not inferred from string matching.
Source-display exactness proxy verifies validated citations, no rejected IDs, cited status, and one visible source per resolved cited ID; the browser deliberately does not display raw internal IDs.
Conversation history is supplied as untrusted bounded context to the pipeline; persistence and ownership flows are measured separately because this frozen runtime has history disabled.
